primitives.name: SoccerNet Dataset

primitives.name: SlowFast Architecture
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Build: (1) reproduce a SlowFast or TSM baseline from PaddleVideo (or a PyTorch equivalent — prefer PyTorch for maintenance) on SoccerNet event classification; (2) fine-tune to NFL play-type/event recognition (formation, play result, personnel); (3) add the pose stream (ST-GCN) for the injury-hazard direction per ledger 0624 §14.
primitives.assumptions: The SlowFast network assumes a dual-stream design where slow and fast branches capture long and short temporal dynamics respectively, with a learnable fusion mechanism.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when the temporal resolution of the input data is insufficient to distinguish between closely spaced actions.

layer2.mapping: The SlowFast architecture's hierarchical feature fusion corresponds to GSE's belief-state update equations, while its multi-scale temporal modeling aligns with GSI's ensemble forecasting methods.
layer2.telemetry: Top-1 accuracy on the fine-tuning task measures architectural effectiveness.

primitives.name: SqueezeTime Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSE implementation spec - Data: start from the survey's public sets for pipeline validation (SoccerNet for event localization — football is the closest team-sport analog), then move to licensed NFL All-22/practice footage.
primitives.assumptions: The SqueezeTime method reduces computational cost by factorizing the convolution kernel along the time dimension, enabling efficient processing of long video sequences.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the factorization introduces artifacts that distort the temporal dependencies essential for action discrimination.

layer2.mapping: The SqueezeTime factorization mirrors GSE's sparse representation techniques for reducing state-space complexity, while its efficiency gains map to GSI's online learning algorithms for rapid adaptation.
layer2.telemetry: Computational throughput and memory footprint serve as key verification metrics alongside accuracy.

primitives.name: ST-GCN Pose Stream
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Applications in GSE order: auto-charting (events, formations) first — it has immediate product value for the content operation; injury-hazard detection second (research).
primitives.assumptions: The Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ST-GCN) processes human pose keypoints as a graph, capturing both spatial body part relationships and temporal motion patterns.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Degenerates when pose estimation errors accumulate, corrupting the graph structure and degrading downstream injury-hazard predictions.

layer2.mapping: The ST-GCN's graph-based message passing aligns with GSE's information fusion protocols, while its ability to model dynamic interactions maps to GSI's causal inference models for hazard assessment.
layer2.telemetry: Keypoint accuracy and injury-risk classification F1-score are critical verification metrics.
